issues.description: The dimensions panel introduces unapproved measurements: 220 mm, 80 mm, 70 mm and 40 mm.
issues.suggested_revision: Remove the numerical dimensions and measurement labels unless approved specifications are supplied.

issues.description: Foldability is not visibly supported. The organizer appears continuous and rigid, with no visible folding mechanism or folded state.
issues.suggested_revision: Show a concept folding mechanism and a folded view, clearly labeled as unapproved, or flag foldability as unresolved.

issues.description: The feature label 'Monolithic form' is an unapproved product claim and may conflict with the required foldable concept.
issues.suggested_revision: Remove the label or replace it with a non-factual concept note pending design approval.

issues.description: No approved reference images or human approval were supplied.
issues.suggested_revision: Retain the concept-review status and obtain approval before treating the design or its details as final.

report.summary: The image depicts a teal organizer with three compartments and rounded corners, but does not demonstrate foldability. It also introduces unapproved dimensions and a monolithic-form claim.
